    omega1 = NArray(

        label=r":math:`c`", default=np.array([5.7]), doc="""Folding parameter c."""

        label=r":math:`k1`",

        doc="""Diffusive coupling from oscillator 2 to 1.""",

    k2 = NArray(
        label=r":math:`k2`",
        default=np.array([0.0]),
        doc="""Diffusive coupling from oscillator 1 to 2.""",
    )

    _nvar = 6
    state_variables = ["x1", "y1", "z1", "x2", "y2", "z2"]

        default={

    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        x1 = state_variables[0, :]
        y1 = state_variables[1, :]
        z1 = state_variables[2, :]
        x2 = state_variables[3, :]
        y2 = state_variables[4, :]
        z2 = state_variables[5, :]

        omega1 = self.omega1
        omega2 = self.omega2
        a = self.a
        b = self.b
        c = self.c
        k1 = self.k1
        k2 = self.k2

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)

        # Derived Variables

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(-z1 - omega1 * y1),  # x1
            np.asarray(a * y1 + k1 * (y2 - y1) + omega1 * x1),  # y1
            np.asarray(b + z1 * (x1 - c)),  # z1
            np.asarray(-z2 - omega2 * y2),  # x2
            np.asarray(a * y2 + k2 * (y1 - y2) + omega2 * x2),  # y2
            np.asarray(b + z2 * (x2 - c)),  # z2
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
